newsitem.title: UK: Govt pay plan to create super-teachers - report.
newsitem.headline: Govt pay plan to create super-teachers - report.

text.p: The UK government is set to announce a radical overhaul of teachers' pay to create a class of high-skill "super-teachers", said a report in The Independent on Wednesday.
The report said the plan will be outlined by the government later on Wednesday and was designed to raise school standards.

The Independent said David Blunkett, secretary of state for education, would make clear in his evidence to the School Teachers Review Body that he does not want extra cash allocated to schools to be soaked up by large pay deals.
As well as creating new super-teachers, the government also wishes to bridge the pay gap between primary school teachers and relatively higher paid secondary school teachers.
